name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_toStateM
lines: ⊢ StateT.run (toStateM (FreeM.pure a)) s₀ = pure (run (FreeM.pure a) s₀)
ih : ∀ (a : ι✝) (s₀ : σ), StateT.run (toStateM (cont a)) s₀ = pure (run (cont a) s₀)
⊢ StateT.run (toStateM (liftBind op cont)) s₀ = pure (run (liftBind op cont) s₀)
ih : ∀ (a s₀ : σ), StateT.run (toStateM (cont a)) s₀ = pure (run (cont a) s₀)
⊢ StateT.run (toStateM (liftBind StateF.get cont)) s₀ = pure (run (liftBind StateF.get cont) s₀)
ih : ∀ (a : PUnit.{u + 1}) (s₀ : σ), StateT.run (toStateM (cont a)) s₀ = pure (run (cont a) s₀)
⊢ StateT.run (toStateM (liftBind (StateF.set a✝) cont)) s₀ = pure (run (liftBind (StateF.set a✝) cont) s₀)

steps.tactic:
induction comp generalizing s₀ with
| pure a => rfl
| liftBind op cont ih => cases op <;> apply ih
